subject: design/feature-draft
statement: An open draft shows advisory overlap only with other same-repository open draft pull requests, compiling each at a verified pinned head.
intent: Let authors see other active work touching the same typed requirement or decision address during a draft.
rationale: The notice intersects compiled claim and decision addresses, including typed links, while keeping observations and failures outside readiness and the lock gate.
fit_criterion: Two open drafts sharing a requirement or decision show reciprocal notices; a closed branch is excluded and notice failure never changes readiness.
